description: LuaHBTeX 1.18.0 and BibTeX; final stable build has no warnings, undefined citations or references, missing characters, or overfull/underfull boxes. The delivered PDF matches all 110 registered statement identifiers and status labels.
visual_qa: All 76 final pages were rendered at 90 dpi and inspected in seven contact sheets. Pages 1, 9, 24, 32, 50, 53, 61, 65, 69 and 75 were additionally inspected at full rendered size. The notation tables, long equations, categorical formulas, proof-audit tables and bibliography showed no clipping, overlap or missing glyphs. An independent text-bounds check found no blocks outside the page safety margins.
